invariants.rationale: Align values are typically non-negative bitfield flags or enumerations in UI code.
Possible alignments in libGDX Scene2D UI are often in the range of 0-15 (combinations of LEFT, RIGHT, TOP, BOTTOM, CENTER).
Align is likely used as a bitmask with valid flags in the lower 4 bits.
Bitwise AND of align with itself is always align; included in case align represents a bitmask.
